title: Hide grid projection from the far boundary

request.text: при таком угле обзора мы не должны видеть клетчатый паттерн дальней грани

decision: Restrict projected grid ink to cutouts whose physical cube boundary faces the camera. Keep existing near-side planar continuity and all geometry.
result: Grid projection is restricted by the physical boundary orientation. Far and edge-on cap/wall patches remain free of grid ink; visible joins retain straight planar grid lines.
checks: GPU regression reproduced 2570 ink pixels on a far cap patch before the fix (fcefb73e-c52b-4e14-a7c1-ccbc531e0e6b).

Focused gridThickness/gridStrength passed (f29741c0-8fb6-4c49-9fab-f37506d4aab1): 72 facing samples, zero hidden-side ink, straight joins before/after orbit, PNG decode/difference and unchanged rock interior/alpha.
